remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running runcomfy commands, and show the model, input media, and output directory before execution.
Recommend a pinned CLI version or a verified installation source instead of an unpinned global npm install.
Warn users that prompts and media URLs are sent to RunComfy, and advise them not to submit confidential or regulated content.
Constrain outputs to a user-selected project directory and avoid writing generated files into sensitive system paths.

content.value_statement: Image-to-video work often fails when the wrong model is chosen. This skill routes each request to a suitable RunComfy model with focused prompt guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes general image animation requests to HappyHorse 1.0 I2V.
Routes custom voiceover lip-sync requests to Wan 2.7 with audio_url.
Routes multi-reference image, video, and audio requests to Seedance 2.0 Pro.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation patterns for each supported route.
Documents key input limits for image, audio, video, duration, and resolution.
Gives prompt guidance for motion, identity stability, lip-sync, and reference ordering.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication.
Sends prompts and media URLs to RunComfy for remote model processing.
Supports one model route per call and does not stitch clips together.
Output length, resolution, and media formats depend on each selected model.

use_cases.title: Create Product Motion Clips
use_cases.description: Turn a product image into a short reveal, orbit, or macro movement for review or campaign drafts.

use_cases.title: Localize Spokesperson Videos
use_cases.description: Generate talking-head variants from separate voiceover files while keeping the visual framing consistent.

use_cases.title: Combine Creative References
use_cases.description: Use image, video, and audio references together to guide subject identity, scene style, and voice tone.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Still Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image with a slow camera drift, subtle subject movement, stable identity, and soft natural light. Use the default route.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Reveal
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this product photo into a short reveal video. Keep packaging unchanged, use a smooth orbit, and add a gradual highlight sweep.

prompt_templates.title: Make a Lip-Synced Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a vertical talking-head video using my voiceover URL. Match the duration to the audio and avoid subtitles, flicker, and distorted hands.

prompt_templates.title: Blend Multiple References
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image 1 for the subject, video 1 for the setting, and audio 1 for voice tone. Make an eight-second warm cafe scene.

output_examples.input: A portrait image needs gentle motion and preserved facial identity.
output_examples.output: The skill selects HappyHorse 1.0 I2V and returns a motion-focused prompt with identity stability guidance.

output_examples.input: A spokesperson clip needs a provided English voiceover track.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7, aligns clip duration to the audio, and includes negative prompt guidance for common artifacts.

output_examples.input: A brand scene needs a subject image, cafe video reference, and voice tone reference.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Seedance 2.0 Pro and explains how to number each reference in the prompt.

best_practices: Use one clear motion beat per clip, such as orbit, dolly, reveal, blink, or breathe.
Keep preservation goals explicit when faces, packaging, or brand elements must stay stable.
Use trusted media URLs and avoid submitting confidential content to remote model services.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for several unrelated camera moves in one short clip.
Do not mix radically different visual styles across image and video references.
Do not force lip-sync requests through the default image-to-video route.

faq.question: Which model does the skill use by default?
faq.answer: It uses HappyHorse 1.0 I2V when the user does not request lip-sync or multi-reference composition.

faq.question: Can it use my own voiceover?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill routes custom voiceover lip-sync requests to Wan 2.7 with an audio_url input.

faq.question: Can it use reference video and audio together?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill routes those requests to Seedance 2.0 Pro when image, video, and audio references are needed.

faq.question: Does it run locally only?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI, but model processing happens through RunComfy remote services.

faq.question: What input media should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide accessible image URLs, and add audio or video URLs only when the selected route needs them.

faq.question: Does it edit or stitch multiple clips?
faq.answer: No. It selects one model route per call and does not perform post-production stitching.
